emma_sales: Pyxis legal asked for a simple, auditable flow for the Private POC credential exchange. They want BYOK + HSM-signed certs and short-lived keys. Can we propose a low-friction ops process they can sign off on?

raj_se: TL;DR: RDW generates CSR + private key locally, customer signs CSR with their HSM CA (TTL <=24h), customer wraps private key with their Vault Transit (or returns presigned S3 with SSE) and returns wrapped ciphertext + signed cert. No plaintext keys over email.

lisa_sec: Requirements from security: HSM attestation on signing, daily cert TTL, audit log for every sign/decrypt, strict IAM for decrypt operations, mTLS for any cert API.

omar_it: We run Vault. Transit is OK. We'll need the exact curl examples and an ops checklist to include in our questionnaire response. Also need a contact in Redwood for the integration window.

raj_se: Ops checklist (pasteable):
- RDW: `openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout rdw.key -out rdw.csr -subj "/CN=rdw-poc"`
- Customer HSM: sign `rdw.csr` -> return `rdw.crt` with TTL <= 24h and write signing event to audit system
- Customer Vault Transit: `curl -s -H "X-Vault-Token: <token>" -X POST -d '{"plaintext":"$(base64 rdw.key)"}' https://vault.example/v1/transit/encrypt/rdw-wrap` -> return `ciphertext`
- Exchange: customer hands `rdw.crt` + `ciphertext` via secure channel (Vault response, S3 presigned, or secure ticket only).
- RDW agent: decrypt via Transit on demand; do not persist raw key.

theo_sales_eng: Add a short pricing note for the PDF: Private POC (2 weeks) includes 1 dedicated pool, HSM onboarding fee (one-time), and optional Audit Export add-on. I'll add dollar ranges in the doc.

lisa_sec: Pasteable AWS KMS policy snippet for their questionnaire: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/rdw-poc"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}`

raj_se: Fallback if Transit not available: accept signed cert + agent outbound mTLS to an approved endpoint; requires VPC ACL + allowlist. Also: bootstrap flow for automation: one manual CSR to issue a bootstrap token, agent uses that token + mTLS to call customer's `/sign` endpoint for renewals.

infra-bot: ticket created POC-4242 assigned raj_se due 2024-07-01

emma_sales: Great. I'll turn this into a 1-page flow + checklist and attach pricing. Omar, please confirm Vault transit availability and GRC contact by EOD Thursday.

omar_it: Will do. If GRC needs an example PDF, ping me and I'll review.
